description: This file contains unit tests for the NaturalStrings utility class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing natural string comparison functions such as compareNaturalAscii, compareNaturalIgnoreCaseAscii, and compareNatural.

classes.name: NaturalStringsTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the correctness of NaturalStrings utility methods in comparing strings in a natural order.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_twoEmptyStrings_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Tests that two empty strings are considered equal by compareNaturalAscii.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_emptyStringComparedToNonEmptyString_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Verifies that an empty string compared to a non-empty string is considered smaller.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_nonEmptyStringComparedToEmptyString_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Verifies that a non-empty string compared to an empty string is considered bigger.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_twoSameOneLetterStrings_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Checks that identical one-letter strings are considered equal.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_twoSameTwoLettersStrings_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Checks that identical two-letter strings are considered equal.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_twoLetterStringComparedToItsOneLetterSubstring_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Verifies that a longer string is considered greater than its substring.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_oneLetterStringComparedToSameStringWithMoreLettersAtTheEnd_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Checks that a shorter string is considered smaller than a longer string with the same prefix.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_oneLetterStringComparedToHigherOneLetterString_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Test: compares 'a' and 'f', expecting the first to be smaller.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_higherOneLetterStringComparedToSmallerOneLetterString_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Test: compares 'f' and 'a', expecting the first to be greater.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_bothStringsAreSingleZeroDigit_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Verifies that '0' and '0' are considered equal.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_bothStringsAreTwoZeros_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Verifies that '00' and '00' are considered equal.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_stringOfOnlyZerosComparedToNonEmptyDigitString_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Checks that zeros-only string is smaller than a digit string.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_nonEmptyDigitStringComparedToStringWithOnlyZeros_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Checks that a digit string is greater than zeros-only string.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_stringOfOnlyZerosComparedToNonEmptyLetterString_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Checks comparison involving zeros and a non-zero letter.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_stringWithDigitOneComparedToStringWithDigitTwo_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Compares '1' and '2'.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_stringWithDigitsZeroOneComparedToStringWithDigitsZeroTwo_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Compares '01' and '02'.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_stringWithDigitsZeroTwoComparedToStringWithDigitsZeroOne_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Compares '02' and '01'.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_sameDigitPrefixedWithMoreZerosComparedToSameDigitPrefixedWithLessZeros_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Compares '0001' and '01'.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_sameDigitPrefixedWithLessZerosComparedToSameDigitPrefixedWithMoreZeros_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Compares '01' and '00001'.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringIsPrefixOfSecondString_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparing a prefix string with a longer string.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringIsSameAsSecondStringButHasMoreDigitsAtTheEnd_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Compare '12' and '1'.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringHasBiggerDigitInTheMiddle_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Compares strings differing in middle digit.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringHasLowerDigitInTheMiddle_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparison where the middle digit of first string is smaller.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringHasLowerDigitInTheMiddleAndSecondStringHasAdditionalDigitAtTheEnd_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparing strings with varying length and digits.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringHasHigherDigitInTheMiddleAndHasMoreDigitsAtTheEndThanOtherString_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Opposite of previous test.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstStringHasHigherDigitInTheMiddleAndEndsWithAdditionalLetter_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Comparison involving additional character at the end.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_sameDigitStringsHaveSameLetterAtTheSamePlaceInTheMiddle_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Testing equality with matching intermediate letters.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_sameDigitStringsButFirstHasSmallerLetterAtTheSamePlaceInTheMiddle_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Test comparing differing letters.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_sameDigitStringsButFirstHasHigherLetterAtTheSamePlaceInTheMiddle_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Test comparing differing letters.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstDigitStringHasSmallerNumberBeforeSameLetterInBothStrings_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparison based on preceding digits.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstDigitStringHasBiggerNumberBeforeSameLetterInBothStrings_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Comparison based on preceding digits.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstDigitStringHasDigitAtTheSamePositionThatOtherStringHasLetter_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Comparing where digit and letter are at same position.

methods.name: compareNaturalAscii_firstDigitStringHasLetterAtTheSamePositionThatOtherStringHasDigit_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Reverse comparison of above.

methods.name: compareNaturalIgnoreCaseAscii_characterStringsWithDifferentCapitalization_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Testing case-insensitive comparison.

methods.name: compareNaturalIgnoreCaseAscii_characterStringsWithLowerCapitalizedLetters_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparing lowercase vs uppercase characters.

methods.name: compareNaturalIgnoreCaseAscii_characterStringsWithLowerLetter_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparison of lowercase characters.

methods.name: compareNatural_firstStringHasLowerLetterComparedToSecondString_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparison of lowercase strings.

methods.name: compareNatural_sameStringsWithOnlyLetters_shouldBeEqual
methods.description: Equality check for identical letter strings.

methods.name: compareNatural_firstStringHasLowerLetterThanSecondStringAtTheSamePositionAfterDigit_shouldBeSmaller
methods.description: Comparison after digit and letter.

methods.name: compareNatural_stringWithLettersComparedToStringStartingWithLetterAndHavingDigit_shouldBeBigger
methods.description: Test: comparing strings with mixed letters and digits, expecting specific order.
